name: relayboard-prototype-workspace
description: Workspace root for the Relayboard prototype: the app in apps/relayboard-web and the Agent Skills package in packages/relayboard-skills. Not published; owns the repository-level TanStack Intent toolchain, the CI gate, and .intent/review-state.json (which Intent always writes at the Git root).

scripts.app:check: npm --prefix apps/relayboard-web run check && npm --prefix apps/relayboard-web run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/relayboard-web run build
